title: What algorithm did Windows XP use to choose your initial user picture?
summary: This blog post from Microsoft's OldNewThing blog explores the historical implementation details of how Windows XP's user account picture selection algorithm worked when creating new user accounts, revealing the randomization logic behind the seemingly simple feature.
problem_solved: Answers a nostalgic but technically interesting question about how Windows XP randomly selected default user account pictures from a predefined set.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how even simple UI features have interesting implementation details, and serves as a window into Windows internals history that appeals to developers curious about system implementation.
